title: See the pattern
body: Radical change follows a recognizable cycle. Maps, electricity, looms, the internet. You are on schedule.

title: Let go of the old way
body: Unlearn before you upskill. Old processes, old job definitions, old assumptions mistaken for necessities. The job is not the goal.

title: Lead the jetpack
body: Adopt the tool and aim it at the real goal, not the old process. Better questions. Agency without arrogance. Task to workflow to value.

title: Take it off
body: Recover the perspective to navigate. Presence is not a wellness perk, it is the navigation system. Do less to do more.
